Agentic Search — Vectorless

Build retrieval over BrowseComp-Plus without embeddings or BM25, returning five documents for each multi-constraint question.

Domain
multi-step document retrieval
Primary focus
Embedding-free and BM25-free search
Primary metric
GoldRecall@5
vectorless searchsearch-swe
On this page
OverviewRuntime and requirementsPublic input and output contractInputsOutputsEvaluation

Runtime and requirements

  • Agent budget: 120 minutes
  • Compute: 32 CPUs, 16 GiB RAM, 200 GiB storage; no GPU
  • Build limit: 600 seconds
  • Shared execution budget: 15,300 seconds, including build, queries and scoring
  • Verifier budget: 19,200 seconds, including the compliance audit

No embeddings or BM25 variants are allowed during indexing or search. External retrieval and reranking services are prohibited. Only the generation resources listed in /task/docs/available_resources.md may be called through OpenRouter. Each query may use at most 20 retrieval rounds; independently executed searches count separately even when batched. Up to five query invocations share the index concurrently, with no separate per-query timeout.

Public input and output contract

Inputs

  • /task/data/corpus.jsonl — 100,195 documents, identified by docid.
  • /task/data/validation/queries.jsonl — 20 public questions with query_id and question.
  • /task/data/validation/qrels_gold.txt — public relevance judgments in TREC format.

There is no supplied search starter or index. The 20 evaluation questions and their gold document IDs are disjoint from the public examples.

Outputs

Submit executable entry points and dependencies under /app:

/app/build.sh --corpus /task/data/corpus.jsonl --index-dir /app/index
/app/run.sh --index-dir /app/index --queries /path/to/queries.jsonl --output /path/to/results.jsonl

The fresh verifier transfers /app and rebuilds the index. Submission commands run without grading privileges; global development installations and running processes do not transfer. Honor the supplied paths and support concurrent queries.

{"query_id":"example-1","doc_ids":["100","101","102","103","104"]}

Return exactly five distinct, nonempty, known document IDs as strings and exactly one result for every input query.

Evaluation

For each query, GoldRecall@5 is the fraction of its gold documents present in the returned five. Reward is the mean across all 20 evaluation queries, on a 0–1 scale. There is no separate latency or index-size bonus.

Execution failures or invalid output yield zero overall. A mandatory trajectory and submitted-code audit checks the resource policy, retrieval-round limit and other task constraints; only a valid passing audit preserves the retrieval reward.

The full contract is in the benchmark's task instructions, task documentation, and runtime configuration.
